  PROBLEM: Test enforces a blunt guard in scripts/render_prompt.sh that rejects any "{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}" in final rendered output, but Semble prefetch for judge prompts will inject chunks from prompts/mode-judge.txt (etc.) containing literal "{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}" (added by this PR), triggering false-positive rejection.
  WHY: Runtime failure: scripts/render_prompt.sh fails judge prompt rendering (non-zero exit, "Unresolved SEMBLE_PREFETCH placeholder") even when Semble correctly prefetches relevant prompt templates, blocking all judge-family LLM invocations with Semble enabled.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:~50-60
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Guard scans entire rendered output for "{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}" without excluding injected SEMBLE_PREFETCH block, so Semble-retrieved judge prompt chunks (containing the placeholder) cause spurious failure despite correct top-level substitution.
  WHY: Runtime failure: Judge prompts fail to render when SEMBLE_ENABLED=true and Semble retrieves indexed prompt templates (e.g., mode-judge.txt line with "{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}"), halting orchestrate_poll_process.sh run_judge() and review_rb_judge.sh.
